industry_updates.title: Trane Technologies Announces Acquisition of Canadian Heat Exchanger Manufacturer Cancoil Thermal
industry_updates.detail: Founded in 1983 with dual manufacturing plants in Ontario, Canada and Jacksonville, Texas, and 450+ employees, producing fluid coolers, air-cooled condensers, and finned-tube heat exchangers (an existing Trane supplier); the transaction is expected to close before the end of the year, with terms undisclosed.

industry_updates.title: Carrier Expands CDU Product Line to 5MW, Secures $3 Billion+ Hyperscaler Agreement
industry_updates.detail: The 1MW CDU has been released, with a 2.6MW version coming in the next 2 months and a 5MW version launching by year-end; data center orders in the first 9 months exceeded $3 billion (+350% YoY), with a $3 billion+ agreement signed with a hyperscaler in early October; full-year data center sales target is set at $2 billion.

industry_updates.title: Vertiv Q3 Organic Orders Double, Completes Microgrid Company Acquisition
industry_updates.detail: Q3 net sales reached $4.313 billion (+61%, organic +55%), full-year sales guidance raised by $650 million to $14.45–14.85 billion; initial cash consideration for the Utility Innovation Group acquisition is approximately $1.45 billion + up to $1.15 billion in earn-outs.

industry_updates.title: Daikin Officially Launches 2.5MW Standalone Liquid-Cooling CDU on Nov 1, Releases VRV 7 in Australia
industry_updates.detail: Units support parallel connection from 400kW to 2.5MW, featuring redundant pumps, dual pressure/temperature sensors, and leak detection; iDCM platform expanded to cover CDU/CRAH/AHU/air walls; Australia's VRV 7 is the first R32 refrigerant VRV platform, delivering a cooling seasonal efficiency ratio 35% higher and heating 42% higher than the previous R410A generation.

industry_updates.title: JCI Releases YORK YMSC Magnetic-Bearing Centrifugal Chiller + MCH-D Dual-Source Air Wall at CIIE
industry_updates.detail: YMSC is an oil-free magnetic-bearing inverter centrifugal water chiller, and MCH-D is a dual-source air wall designed for high-density cooling of AI computing power (dual-source architecture + intelligent collaborative control; specific capacity/energy efficiency parameters not disclosed).

industry_updates.title: Shenling Environment Issues 1 Billion RMB Convertible Bonds, Invests 800 Million RMB in Liquid-Cooling Intelligent Manufacturing Base
industry_updates.detail: Shunde liquid-cooling advanced intelligent manufacturing base (land certificate, filing, and EIA completed), adding production capacity for nearly 20,000 units of liquid-cooling equipment; the company stated that existing liquid-cooling capacity is approaching saturation; data service sector new orders in H1 reached 2.3 times the same period last year.

industry_updates.title: Third Revision of US Section 338 Tariff List on Canada Effective Oct 30
industry_updates.detail: A 50% ad valorem tariff added to air conditioning equipment, valves, carpets, and horizontal freezers, while certain mechanical refrigeration equipment was removed; USMCA originating goods are not exempt and can be stacked with Section 232.

siphon_effects.detail: Micron October earnings report: data center DRAM gross margin reached 90% (41% a year ago), CEO states 2027 and 2028 will be tighter than 2026; TrendForce: in 2027, nine cloud vendors will purchase approximately $1.02 trillion in memory ≈ 96% of that year's global memory market.

Yageo plans a new round of price increases from late October to November: high-capacitance up 50%+, medium-to-low capacitance up 10%-30%; Murata capacity utilization at 95%, AI server high-capacitance market share approx. 70%; Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q4 consumer-grade X5R up 25%-30%, high-end X6S up 10%-20%; lead times for high-end part numbers at 5-10 months.

Kingboard raised prices by +15% on copper-clad laminates using 2116 and thinner glass-fiber cloth on Oct 13 (8th round this year); November electronic yarn/cloth generally up MoM (G75 yarn +3,000 RMB/ton, 2116 thin cloth +2.5 RMB/meter); FR-4 lead time extended from a few days to approx. 4 weeks; TPCA expects tightness to continue into 2027.

CICC confirmed the price hike wave on Nov 3 (Infineon, TI, onsemi, ST collectively); onsemi implemented a 5%-15% hike on MOSFETs/IGBTs/SiC starting Oct 10, with ongoing transmission; general MOSFET lead times extended from 8-12 weeks to approx. 30 weeks, automotive-grade IGBTs/SiC at 40-50 weeks; Infineon expects tightness to last 2-3 years.

Wood Mackenzie: 2026 power transformer shortage at 15%, average lead time 128 weeks (approx. 2.5 years); US August 31 executive order bans imports of bulk Chinese power equipment; Eaton stated on Nov 3 that its Electrical Americas backlog is +33% YoY.

cross_industry.detail: Automotive chip price hike wave, NXP's third price adjustment of the year effective Jan 1, 2027 (Infineon, ST, TI, Renesas, Vishay with intensive price adjustments this year); automotive-grade memory overall up approx. 180% from March to June 2026; 15+ automakers raised retail prices or implemented disguised price hikes; shares MCUs, memory, and power devices with HVAC.

Kehua Digital Energy raised prices across its entire lineup by 5%-15% starting Nov 1; Huawei Digital Power issued a letter on Oct 20 proposing a 5%-15% hike (customer-by-customer negotiations, effective date TBD); Sungrow already raised prices on Sep 20, Inovance raised energy storage PCS prices by 5%-15% in August.

Ministry of Commerce Announcement No. 48: public solicitation of opinions on incorporating cutting-edge AI-related items into export controls (40 technologies proposed for addition, 23 of which belong to AI), temporary export registration has taken effect, public comment period from Oct 16 to Nov 15; indicates tightening compliance criteria for dual-use item exports.

EU CBAM final phase took effect on Jan 1, 2026 (Omnibus simplified version); Q3 2026 certificate price at 82.32 euros (+9.4% MoM); planned expansion to approx. 180 downstream products by 2028 (including steel/aluminum components); impacts export costs of copper, aluminum, and steel used in HVAC to Europe.
